question: Which sport is the Durand cup is associated with?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Football.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Durand Cup:** The Durand Cup is one of **the oldest football tournaments in India, established in 1888.**
 
• **Significance:** It is named after Sir Henry Mortimer Durand, who was the British Deputy Commissioner of Bengal and initiated the tournament to foster goodwill between the Indian and British communities.
 
• **Teams:** The tournament features clubs from various states, including top teams from the Indian Super League (ISL) and the I-League.
 
• The tournament celebrates the rich legacy and spirit of football.
 
• Historical Context: The Durand Cup has a rich history and has been held in various formats over the years, making it a significant event in Indian football.
 
• Recent Developments: The tournament has evolved over the years, with new teams and formats introduced to enhance competition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tournament: The 2024 Durand Cup, which was the 133rd edition of Asia's oldest football tournament.
 
• Winner: NorthEast United.
 
• Defeated: Defending champions Mohun Bagan SG.
 
• Achievement: NorthEast United won their first-ever trophy in club history.
